data.name: Muhazib
data.gender_notes: Muhazib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who gives knowledge or information. The name Muhazib carries the meaning “Knowledge Giver” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Muhazib usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge giver and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are wise, knowledgeable, and have a deep understanding of the divine
data.etymology: Muhazib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge Giver.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhazib total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: مُهَظِب
in_arabic.long_meaning: مُهَظِب هو اسم عربي مشتق من حظب الذي يعني الرقابة أو السيطرة، ويشير إلى الشخص الذي يحظى بالسيطرة أو الرقابة، وله أهمية في التراث الإسلامي حيث يُركز على الرقابة الذاتية والسيطرة على النفس

in_urdu.name: مہزب
in_urdu.long_meaning: مہزب ایک عربی نام ہے جو حظب سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے نگرانی یا قابو، اور اس سے مراد وہ شخص ہے جو نگرانی یا قابو رکھتا ہے، اور اس کی اہمیت جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم روایت میں ہے جہاں خود کو قابو کرنے اور نگرانی پر زور دیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: मुहज़िब
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहज़िब एक अरबी नाम है जो ह़ज़ब से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है संरक्षण या नियंत्रण, और इसका अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो संरक्षण या नियंत्रण करता है, और इसका महत्व भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में है जहां आत्म-नियंत्रण और संरक्षण पर जोर दिया जाता है

in_pashto.name: مهزب
in_pashto.long_meaning: مهزب د عربی نوم دی چې د हजب څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د ساتنې یا کنترول معنا لري، او دا د هغه شخص په مانا دی چې ساتنه یا کنترول کوي، او دا د افغان/پشتون دود İz میں重要 دی چېرې چې د ځان ساتنه او کنترول ته ټینګار کیږي

in_english.name: Muhazib
in_english.long_meaning: Muhazib is an Arabic name derived from hazb, meaning guardianship or control, referring to a person who exercises guardianship or control, and has significance in Islamic tradition where self-control and guardianship are emphasized

data.cultural_impact: The name Muhazib holds great significance in Islamic culture due to its connection with education and the dissemination of knowledge. The Arabic root words "al-Hadh" (giving or supplying) and "Zahaba" (extensive or detailed) convey a sense of sharing comprehensive and insightful information. This name is an encouragement for individuals to seek knowledge and enlightenment, contributing to the growth and advancement of both the individual and society.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Muhazib can be found in the Quranic concept of Ilm (knowledge) and Hikmah (wisdom). The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, emphasized the importance of seeking knowledge and stated that it is a part of faith. The name Muhazib stands as a reminder of the divine wisdom bestowed upon us, encouraging us to utilize the knowledge to serve others and draw closer to the All-Knowing Creator, Allah. In essence, the name Muhazib serves as an inspiration to become facilitators of divine knowledge and spread it among others, ultimately contributing to the betterment of the world.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Knowledge Giver" symbolizes One who gives knowledge or information. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Muhazib serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of knowledge giver.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir's Al-Bidayah wa'l-Nihayah, under the chapter of 'The Battle of Uhud'. Muhazib ibn Mas'ud is mentioned as a companion of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) who contributed significantly to the Islamic cause during the Battle of Uhud.
historical_references.context: Muhazib was a Companion of the Prophet (peace be upon him) who participated in the Battle of Uhud (625 AD). During the battle, he fought bravely and when the Muslims were on the verge of being defeated, he exhorted and encouraged his fellow Muslims to hold their ground and not retreat. His words were instrumental in rallying the Muslims and turning the tide of the battle in favor of the Islamic army.

historical_references.reference: Al-Tabari's Tarikh al-Rusul wa'l-Muluk, under the chapter of 'The Battle of Hunayn'. Muhazib ibn Mas'ud is mentioned as a prominent leader of the Islamic army during the Battle of Hunayn (630 AD).
historical_references.context: Muhazib was a prominent leader in the Islamic army during the Battle of Hunayn, which took place in 630 AD. He was appointed as the commander of the right wing of the army by the Caliph, Ali ibn Abi Talib (RA). Muhazib led his troops bravely and played a crucial role in the Islamic army's victory over the Meccan forces.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Muhazib, an Islamic name meaning 'generous with knowledge', is increasingly being used as part of personal branding efforts in the digital age. This name can be seen on professional networking sites like LinkedIn, where individuals may include it in their profile to highlight their religious and cultural identity. Instagram, a visual platform, can also be used to showcase a personal brand, and some individuals may use Muhazib as a handle to convey a message of generosity and knowledge sharing. Lastly, Twitter, a microblogging platform, can be used to engage in conversations and share knowledge, further reinforcing the meaning behind the name.

name_in_real_life.story: Aisha Muhazib, a teacher in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, shares that their name Muhazib meaning "Knowledge Giver" has been a source of inspiration throughout their life, motivating them to be a positive influence in their community.
